//: Workspace settings for Cursor / VS Code. Checked in so every contributor sees the same Python linter behaviour. ESLint and Robot Framework configuration live in their own files (frontend/eslint.config.mjs, .robocop, robotidy.toml).
//-python-linting: Switch from pylint (697 false-positive Problems on this codebase due to weak FastAPI/SQLAlchemy/Enum analysis) to ruff + basedpyright. ruff covers correctness via pyflakes-class rules in pyproject.toml; basedpyright is responsible for type-level checks. If pylint is still installed, the disables in pyproject.toml keep it from spamming the Problems panel either.
//-python-analysis: basedpyright (via ms-python.python) handles type-aware diagnostics. Mode 'basic' is the right default for a codebase that doesn't have full type coverage yet; bump to 'strict' once the migration is complete.
//-ruff: Ruff is installed via 'py -3 -m pip install ruff' (also runs from the agent-side lint hook). The 'charliermarsh.ruff' VS Code extension picks up [tool.ruff] from pyproject.toml automatically.
//-explorer: Hide noise-generating folders in the file tree so they don't compete with source files for attention. Files are still searchable; this is purely a display hint.
//-recommend-installing: The agent-side lint hook in .cursor/hooks.json depends on these dev tools being present. Install with: py -3 -m pip install ruff basedpyright; npm i -g (optional, npx works) eslint
